title: Your Body's Hidden Speed
hook: Your nerves fire faster than a Formula 1 car
script: Your nerves fire faster than a Formula 1 car What if they were slower? You already feel a stubbed toe a beat late Nerve signals can travel up to 270 miles per hour That's about 120 meters every second, quicker than a Formula 1 car at full throttle, all happening inside your own body This speed is why you react so quickly to danger Your body is faster than you think, and it's all thanks to your nerves
